entries.text: I am pretty stressed with work , but otherwise content and appreciative of the pleasant fall day and weather . I had a nice , productive lunch with coworkers and someone who was interviewing , so overall quite nice .

Currently I am tired and am having some canker sores , which is making it hard to eat . I feel pretty exhausted from the day , and still have some work left to do to prepare for tomorrow . Other than that , I feel like I am super busy and need more time to do all of the things I need to .

I’m a bit hungry , but I feel super refreshed after a 5km water along the water . Definitely helped to clear the mind and feel happy going into the weekend ! I definitely feel more relaxed and less overwhelmed after today’s work meetings .

I’m currently feeling refreshed after a good night’s rest , and feeling relaxed with a quiet morning having breakfast . I’m looking forward to the day ahead ; it’s supposed to be beautiful outside on this warm fall day , and the sun is out . So much to be thankful for !
